meta.title: Contact — Let's talk about Mexico | Forcelis
meta.description: Book a 20-minute call or tell us what you're evaluating in Mexico. We'll reply within one business day.

hero.title: Let's talk about Mexico.
hero.subtitle: 20 minutes, no cost. Tell me what you're evaluating and I'll tell you honestly whether a study makes sense.

schedule.title: Fastest: pick a time
schedule.body: Open the calendar, choose a 20-minute slot and we'll talk. No preparation needed.

formIntro.title: Or write to me
formIntro.body: If you'd rather share some context first, fill this in and I'll reply within one business day.

form.name: Name
form.message: What are you evaluating in Mexico?
form.messageHint: A sentence or two is enough: the product or sector, and the decision you need to make.
form.consent: I have read the Privacy Notice and agree that Forcelis may use this information to reply.
form.successBody: Thank you. I'll reply to the email you left.
form.errorBody: Something went wrong on the way. Try again in a few minutes, or book a time in the calendar.
form.unconfiguredBody: This site has no form service configured, so nothing would be delivered. In the meantime, book a time in the calendar.

errors.email: Enter a valid email — for example, name@company.com
errors.minLength: Please write a little more — at least {min} characters.
errors.consent: Accept the Privacy Notice to continue.
errors.tooFast: One moment: press Send again in a couple of seconds.
errors.branches: Enter a number of 0 or more.

steps.title: I read it myself
steps.body: No assistant, no routing rules. I read it and I reply.

steps.title: 20 minutes
steps.body: A short call to understand your company and the decision you're facing.

steps.title: An honest answer
steps.body: I'll tell you which study makes sense, or that none does.

items.title: No obligation
items.body: The first call is free and commits you to nothing.

items.title: Confidential
items.body: What you share stays between us, whether or not there's a project.

items.title: Your language
items.body: English, Spanish or Portuguese; Italian and Japanese too.
